meta.description: Terms of use for HeatEx Direct, an independent sourcing information platform for Chinese industrial heat exchanger manufacturers, product profiles, industry content, and quote request intake.
meta.keywords: HeatEx Direct terms, heat exchanger sourcing platform terms, China manufacturer directory terms, industrial sourcing information terms

hero.title: Terms of Use
hero.subtitle: These terms explain how HeatEx Direct may be used as an independent sourcing information platform for industrial heat exchanger buyers and suppliers.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing HeatEx Direct, browsing manufacturer or product pages, reading industry content, submitting a quote request, contacting us, or requesting a manufacturer profile update, you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree with these terms, please do not use the website or submit information through it.

platformRole.title: 2. What HeatEx Direct Provides
platformRole.content: HeatEx Direct is an independent information platform focused on Chinese industrial heat exchanger manufacturers. We organize company background, product capabilities, application sectors, export markets, media assets, available files, industry articles, and structured quote request intake so buyers can conduct more informed preliminary research.

notManufacturer.title: 3. We Are Not a Manufacturer or Trading Party
notManufacturer.content: HeatEx Direct does not manufacture heat exchangers, sell physical products, issue binding quotations on behalf of suppliers, inspect finished goods, or become a party to any purchase order, supply contract, payment, logistics arrangement, warranty, or dispute between a buyer and a supplier.

permittedUse.title: 4. Permitted Use
permittedUse.content: You may use the website for legitimate B2B research, supplier comparison, product education, manufacturer profile review, quote request preparation, manufacturer profile correction, and content or partnership inquiries. You may not use the website for unlawful activity, automated scraping, data resale, spam, impersonation, misleading submissions, or attempts to disrupt the website.

quoteRequests.title: 5. Quote Requests and Follow-Up
quoteRequests.content: Quote request forms are intended to collect project context and technical parameters such as media, flow, temperatures, pressure, materials, standards, quantity, and notes. Submitting a request does not guarantee supplier acceptance, quotation, pricing, delivery, technical suitability, or commercial outcome. We may review the request, ask clarifying questions, and use a verifiable email address to follow up.

manufacturerProfiles.title: 6. Manufacturer Profiles and Updates
manufacturerProfiles.content: Manufacturer profiles may include public information, supplier-provided materials, translated or summarized descriptions, images, files, certificates, product pages, and editorial context. Manufacturers or authorized representatives may ask us to correct or update profile information, but we reserve the right to review, edit, reject, or remove submissions that are incomplete, unverifiable, misleading, promotional beyond reasonable limits, or outside the scope of this platform.

contentAccuracy.title: 7. Information Accuracy and Buyer Due Diligence
contentAccuracy.content: We aim to organize information in a clear and inspectable way, but website content is provided for preliminary research and may be incomplete, outdated, translated, summarized, or based on third-party sources. Buyers remain responsible for final supplier due diligence, technical validation, certifications, compliance checks, contract terms, quality inspections, and purchase decisions.

intellectualProperty.title: 8. Content and Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.content: Unless otherwise stated, the website structure, written content, translations, page layouts, data organization, and editorial materials are owned by or licensed to HeatEx Direct. Supplier names, logos, documents, product images, and other third-party materials may belong to their respective owners and are used for identification, profile, or informational purposes.

privacy.title: 9. Privacy and Communications
privacy.content: Information you submit through quote request, contact, profile update, and content partnership workflows is handled according to our Privacy Policy. By submitting information, you authorize us to use it for platform operation, request review, communication, supplier profile management, and relevant follow-up as described in that policy.

liability.title: 10. Disclaimer and Limitation of Liability
liability.content: The website and its content are provided on an as-is and as-available basis. To the maximum extent permitted by law, HeatEx Direct is not liable for losses arising from reliance on website content, supplier decisions, technical mismatch, commercial disputes, delivery delays, quality issues, data interruptions, or third-party actions.

changes.title: 11. Changes to These Terms
changes.content: We may update these Terms of Use as the website, content model, sourcing workflows, or legal requirements change. Updated terms will be posted on this page. Continued use of HeatEx Direct after changes are posted means you accept the updated terms.
